ENUMA / TECHNICAL REPORT

Unifying Camera, Language, and Visual Controls for Interactive World Modeling

Read abstract ↗

ENUMA is a unified interactive world model supporting camera trajectories, language events, and visual references. Reference Forcing adapts a bidirectional video generator to chunk-wise causal generation, then distills it for efficient rollout. The model is evaluated on established world-model benchmarks, ENUMA-Bench, and human preference comparisons.
